name: dsh-session-messenger
description: Cross-session coordination for DSH: file-claim registry (manual claim_files plus auto-registration from fs write intents), multi-round structured negotiation (negotiate) with a dispute-scoped write freeze via tools.guard, a watchdog that escalates to the human and never auto-favours the writer, and rate-limited peer messaging (send_to_session) within one workspace.

scripts.probe: node probe-cordis-load.mjs && SKIP_PROVIDER=1 node probe-cordis-load.mjs && node probe-l0-autoregister.mjs && node probe-negotiation.mjs
